evidence.title: Simulation boundary - Packet Tracer traffic is not visible to Suricata/Wireshark on Kali
evidence.detail: Packet Tracer executes an independent simulation. No capture interface exports its frames to the Kali host, so Suricata and Wireshark cannot see any traffic from this topology. Therefore: (a) network status data on this dashboard is SIMULATION EVIDENCE, labelled as such; (b) Suricata detections come from real traffic on the Kali/VMware path. Any claim of a bridge between the two would be false unless a capture bridge (e.g. a tap feeding a real interface) is actually built and verified.
evidence.observed: Two independent evidence planes, deliberately kept separate.

live_collection.reason: Cisco Packet Tracer devices do not expose SSH/SNMP/Telnet management interfaces to external collectors. Live collection is only meaningful against real hardware or GNS3/CSR/CML images.
live_collection.enable_instructions: Set SOC_CISCO_LIVE_ENABLED=true and SOC_CISCO_LIVE_HOSTS=<ip:port,...> only after confirming the target devices really accept read-only management connections. The adapter performs TCP reachability probing first and reports failures instead of synthesising data.
